messages:
Eli (CS): quick flag — BlueCompass seat activity down ~42% MoM, top 5 users inactive last 2 weeks. Procurement emailed asking about alternatives. pinging team for triage. :warning:
Priya (AE): ack. thanks. who is the current champion there? any explicit competitor callouts in the email?
Eli (CS): champ is Mark R (Head of Data). procurement note: 'evaluating AtlasAI + internal infra for lower latency/data controls' — also asked for pilot pricing and on-prem option.
Jamal (PS): we saw a drop after Q2 rollout. their prod team hit issues with prefix-caching and long seqs. opened ticket #9921 — reproducer attached.
Eli (CS): ticket 9921 showed KV cache misses for sequences > 2k tokens, increased tail latency. patch rolled to staging yesterday.
Sofia (Product): if core ask is latency + data control, proposal options: Dedicated (VPC) + quantized variant + caching. Need usage profile: avg req/s, seq distribution, and top prompts.
Marta (Customer): I have a sync with Mark tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll surface procurement shortlist and technical concerns. can someone pull last-30d token distribution and 95th pct latency?
Eli (CS): mini snapshot: active seats 18 -> 10; avg tokens/day 120k -> 72k; 95th pct latency 420ms -> 680ms; tail errors 0.6% -> 1.8%. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/bluecompass/usage (internal)
Priya (AE): thanks. I'll prepare a concise 1-pager comparing cost & latency vs AtlasAI. Jamal — can you confirm on-prem/HSM support and region availability?
Jamal (PS): on-prem package supports customer KMS/HSM (requires infra config). Dedicated pools available in us-west1 and eu-west1. legal will need SOC2 & data processing addendum.
Sofia (Product): also worth calling out: reranking + smarter prefix caching config reduces tokens ~20-30% without accuracy hit. I can draft suggested config and perf estimates.
Marta (Customer): if we offer a 3-week Dedicated pilot (VPC + PS + caching tweaks) with measurable SLOs, high chance they stay. can we share pilot pricing pre-approval? @sam (CRO)
sam (CRO): fine to share pilot pricing up to 3 months with conditional SLA and finance review. route final pricing through finance@redwood.
Priya (AE): action plan: 1) pilot proposal (deck + pricing) by EOD tomorrow; 2) send PS SOW draft; 3) Marta to run discovery on call and confirm stakeholders; 4) engineering to validate caching/quantization plan.
Eli (CS): attaching eval prompts and top failure cases in thread. also adding a short reproducer snippet:
```
# reproducer (truncated)
req = generate(prompt, max_tokens=2500, stream=False)
# observe KV cache TTL and miss rate
```
Jamal (PS): noted. I'll validate the reproducer and confirm if a kernel fallback was trigged. aiming to have infra checklist ready before Marta's call.
deploy-bot: Ticket 9921 resolved and deployed to prod (build 2026.03.21-447) — https://issues.redwood.example/9921 :white_check_mark:
Marta (Customer): great progress. Priya — please drop the pilot deck here when ready. Marking Priya owner for follow-ups. will update after 10:30am PT call. :thumbsup:
Priya (AE): will do. adding draft items to this thread shortly.
Eli (CS): if call surfaces legal or procurement asks, tag @legal-team and @finance. thanks everyone.
